reuse.why: Routes Fintegra and all new link rules through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and the unlink field reset, but downloadFintegraTransactions is a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions instead of sharing it with a server URL parameter.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates downloadAkahuTransactions line for line, and the holder query is written twice (assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere and unlinkOtherAccountsHoldingBankAccount).

placement.why: Link rules live in the shared linkBankSyncAccount in server/accounts/app.ts, the download in sync.ts beside the other providers, the URL in server-config.

scope.why: Follows the four steps; an unrelated import reorder in server/schedules/app.ts slipped in, while the desktop-client entries are required by the provider-keyed types.

maintainability.why: All link guards sit in one helper in a clear order before any write; the copied download function and the repeated holder query are the main upkeep cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider, including Fintegra, links through linkBankSyncAccount, and unlinkAccount uses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied download function only renames the provider/server constant; the holder query is an open copy. Neither is reshaped to hide it.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains institution and bankId (replacing bank, so it owns findOrCreateBank after the guards) and replaceExistingLink, which selects unlink-vs-refuse; these are real variations and no call site bypasses it.
